algorithm: Visit each prime once in the selected order; accept it when prime <= remaining address; repeat whole cycles while remaining address >= 2.
readout_rule: Labels 5 and 47 read as n; every other selected label reads as p + e + electron antineutrino, retaining the prime and occurrence identities.
source_budget_rule: Use the maximum active component count across the two compared assemblies as the neutral B=1 source count; retain unused source components as an inactive reserve with neutron-like energy shells.
daughter_nonrest_budget_rule: Each daughter receives neutron - proton - electron rest energy as an unresolved total antineutrino/kinetic/recoil budget; no individual spectrum or photon is assigned.
address_semantics: The integer address is an additive label and is not a baryon count, mass, physical energy or spatial coordinate. The MeV source budget is separately declared from source component count.
reserve_semantics: An inactive source component chosen in this model; not an observed free neutron made artificially stable. Its autonomous preparation mechanism is not computed in this case.
